title: ATAR native vouch
description: A signed ATAR vouch (SPEC §3): a signed payload plus the hex-encoded Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the payload.

claim.description: Optional free text, used only for self-vouches (SPEC §3).

evidence.description: Optional references to the observations behind the score (SPEC §3.2); part of the signed claim when present.

signature.description: Lowercase hex Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of payload.

did.description: did:key (multibase base58btc) or legacy did:agent: identifier (SPEC §2).
